llm.summary: This instruction-only Obsidian organizer appears purpose-aligned, but it should be reviewed because it tells the agent to broadly read and modify notes, delete or merge files, and write persistent agent memory without clear confirmation or retention limits.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is Obsidian note restructuring, which fits read/search/write behavior, but the instructions also require persistent agent-memory writes and broad vault-wide/batch operations that are not clearly bounded.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The workflow uses mandatory language for searching, creating relationship notes, deleting invalid relationship notes, patching skill notes, and writing memory, without explicit user confirmation, backup, or rollback guidance.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec, binaries, environment variables, credentials, or code files are present; the package is instruction-only.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Reading and modifying an Obsidian vault is proportional to the skill, but the artifacts do not clearly define path limits, exclusions, approval gates, or handling of private note contents during broad searches.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill explicitly requires writing agent memory fragments after note work, creating persistent state that may retain private user context across tasks.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable letting the agent inspect and restructure your Obsidian vault. Before use, set a limited vault path, keep backups, require approval before destructive or batch edits, and disable or explicitly approve any agent-memory writes.

evidence.explanation: The skill instructs the agent to delete or merge Obsidian relationship notes based on its own classification, but does not require confirmation, backups, or reversible changes before destructive edits.
evidence.snippet: 四类无效→处理：线连线 ... 删除；零端 ... 删除；单端 ... 删除；多线 ... 合并为一条

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Require explicit user approval before deleting, merging, renaming, or batch-patching notes, and recommend backups or a dry-run summary first.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: A mistaken classification could remove or merge user notes in the vault.

evidence.explanation: The batch workflow can modify frontmatter across all skill-tagged notes without a stated scope limit, preview, or confirmation step.
evidence.snippet: 流程C：批量改造 skill 笔记加 agent_trigger ... 找出所有 skill 笔记 ... patch 写入 frontmatter

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Limit batch edits to user-selected files, show a proposed change list, and ask for confirmation before applying patches.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: The agent could make widespread metadata changes across the user's note vault from one broad instruction.

evidence.explanation: The workflow requires writing persistent agent memory after note operations, but does not define what data may be stored, retention limits, user approval, or how private note content is protected.
evidence.snippet: ⚠️ **写 agent memory 碎片**（强制，不可跳过）

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Make memory writes opt-in, summarize exactly what will be stored, avoid storing sensitive note contents by default, and provide retention/deletion guidance.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: Private note details or decisions could be saved into persistent agent memory and reused in later tasks.

evidence.explanation: The skill is designed to search and load Obsidian notes using L0/L1/L2 layers, which is purpose-aligned but involves reading potentially private local knowledge-base content.
evidence.snippet: 任务前搜索笔记，按层级加载，节省 token。

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Configure a specific vault path and exclusions, and ask the agent to report which files it plans to read before broad searches.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: The agent may read parts of many private notes while organizing the vault.

abnormal_behavior_control.summary: The skill gives the agent authority to delete, merge, rename, create, and batch-patch notes without clear approval or rollback requirements.

permission_boundary.summary: No credentials, tokens, account privileges, or external delegated authority are requested in the artifacts.

sensitive_data_protection.summary: The skill uses broad note search/loading and requires persistent agent-memory writes, with no clear storage, retention, or consent boundaries.
